hero.title: New furnished suites, a short walk from Salalah Gardens Mall
hero.lead: A sitting room, a kitchen and a quiet bedroom of your own: for a family holiday, a khareef week or a longer stay.

rooms.intro: Every suite has its own sitting room, kitchen and bathroom; they differ in the bedroom. Pick the one that suits you and tell us your dates.
rooms.stay: By the night, the week or longer: ask us
rooms.bathroomText: A fridge, a gas cooker with an oven and a sink in the larger kitchens, plus a washing machine; a microwave and a dining table in the kitchenettes. Layouts vary from suite to suite, so tell us what you need.

double.name: Double suite
double.short: One wide bed, sitting room, kitchen
double.desc: A wide double bed with a gold runner, lamps on both sides and a lit panelled headboard wall. Through the door, a sitting room with a cream sofa and a wall-mounted TV behind floor-length curtains, then the kitchen and the bathroom.
steps: The double bed under the lit headboard wall
The sitting room with the sofa and the TV
The kitchen: cooker, oven, fridge and washing machine

twin.name: Twin suite
twin.short: Two single beds, sitting room, kitchen
twin.desc: Two single beds with gold-trimmed runners and a lamp between them, for friends, colleagues or children. The sitting room has a sofa, glass nesting tables and a woven floor lamp; the kitchenette has a microwave and a small dining table.
steps: Two beds under the lit panelled wall
The sitting room with the floor lamp
The kitchenette and the dining table

clean.d: “Clean new apartments”, in one guest's words. The suites were renovated recently and it shows.

host.d: Guests name the host in their reviews. Write on WhatsApp and you deal with a person.

location.d: Salalah Gardens Mall and the Chinese Village are a few minutes on foot; the airport is a short drive.

kitchen.d: Every suite has a kitchen or a kitchenette, so breakfast and late dinners are yours.

parking.d: Park by the building at no charge: handy for a hire car in khareef.

wifi.d: In every suite, with a smart TV in the sitting room.

renovation.title: Not a room: a small home
renovation.text: A bedroom with the door closed, a sitting room where the children can watch TV, a kitchen for the morning coffee and a washing machine for a long trip. That's the difference between a suite and a hotel room, and why families stay here.

gallery.intro: Swipe through the bedrooms, the sitting rooms and the kitchens.

khareef.now: It's khareef season — Salalah's hills are green and the mist is in.
khareef.later: Next khareef: late June to early September.

salalah.intro: Salalah is the only corner of Arabia with a monsoon. From late June the hills behind the city turn green; the rest of the year it is beaches, frankincense and souqs. From the suites, the mall is a walk and the rest is a short drive.
salalah.byAir: From Salalah Airport: a short taxi ride.
salalah.byBus: From the bus station: a short taxi ride west.
salalah.byRoad: By road from Muscat: around 10 hours on the Route 31 highway.
